items.source:
Supports a Quartz day-of-month/week field with an L/# expression. Follows
common cron conventions in every other respect, including 0-6 for SUN-SAT
(plus 7 for SUN as well). Note that Quartz deviates from the day-of-week
convention in cron through 1-7 for SUN-SAT whereas Spring strictly follows
cron even in combination with the optional Quartz-specific L/# expressions.
items.translation: 支持带有 L/# 表达式的 Quartz 日/周字段。除遵循常见的 cron 约定外（包括 0-6 表示周日到周六，外加 7 也表示周日），请注意 Quartz 在日/周字段的约定上与 cron 不同，采用 1-7 表示周日到周六；而 Spring 即使在结合可选的 Quartz 专用 L/# 表达式时，也严格遵循 cron 约定。

items.source:
The "day of month" and "day of week" fields can contain a L-character, which stands for "last", and has a different meaning in each field:
  • In the "day of month" field, L stands for "the last day of the month". If followed by an negative offset (i.e. L-n), it means "nth-to-last day of the month". If followed by W (i.e. LW), it means "the last weekday of the month".
  • In the "day of week" field, dL or DDDL stands for "the last day of week d (or DDD) in the month".
items.translation:
“月中的日期”和“星期几”字段可以包含一个 `L` 字符，该字符代表“最后”，但在每个字段中具有不同的含义：
  • 在“月中的日期”字段中，L 代表“当月的最后一天”。如果后面跟有负偏移量（即 L-n），则表示“当月倒数第 n 天”。如果后面跟有 W（即 LW），则表示“当月的最后一个工作日”。
  • 在“星期几”字段中，dL 或 DDDL 代表“当月最后一周的 d（或 DDD）天”。

items.source: The "day of month" field can be nW, which stands for "the nearest weekday to day of the month n". If n falls on Saturday, this yields the Friday before it. If n falls on Sunday, this yields the Monday after, which also happens if n is 1 and falls on a Saturday (i.e. 1W stands for "the first weekday of the month").
items.translation: "日"字段可以是 `nW`，表示“最接近月中的第 `n` 天的工作日”。如果 `n` 是星期六，则指其前一个星期五。如果 `n` 是星期日，则指其后一个星期一；这也适用于当 `n` 为 `1` 且是星期六的情况（即 `1W` 表示“该月的第一个工作日”）。

items.source: The "day of week" field can be d#n (or DDD#n), which stands for "the n-th day of week d (or DDD) in the month".
items.translation: "星期"字段可以是 `d#n`（或 `DDD#n`），表示“该月的第 `n` 个星期 `d`（或 `DDD`）”。

items.source: "@yearly" (or "@annually") to run un once a year, i.e. "0 0 0 1 1 *"
items.translation: `"@yearly"`（或 `"@annually"`）用于每年运行一次，即 `"0 0 0 1 1 *"`。

items.source: "@daily" (or "@midnight") to run once a day, i.e. "0 0 0 * * *"
items.translation: `"@daily"`（或 `"@midnight"`）每天运行一次，即 `"0 0 0 * * *"`。

items.source: A field may be an asterisk (*), which always stands for "first-last". For the "day of the month" or "day of the week" fields, a question mark (?) may be used instead of an asterisk.
items.translation: 字段可以是星号（*），始终代表“首尾”。对于“月份中的日期”或“星期中的日期”字段，可以使用问号（?）代替星号。

items.source: Following a range (or *) with /n specifies the interval of the number's value through the range.
items.translation: 跟随范围（或 `*`）的 `/n` 指定了该范围内数值值的间隔。

items.source: "@monthly" to run once a month, i.e. "0 0 0 1 * *"
items.translation: `"@monthly"` 每月运行一次，即 `"0 0 0 1 * *"`。

items.source: "@weekly" to run once a week, i.e. "0 0 0 * * 0"
items.translation: "@weekly" 每周运行一次，即 "0 0 0 * * 0"。

items.source: "@hourly" to run once an hour, i.e. "0 0 * * * *"
items.translation: `"@hourly"` 每小时运行一次，即 `"0 0 * * * *"`。

items.source: Ranges of numbers are expressed by two numbers separated with a hyphen (-). The specified range is inclusive.
items.translation: 数字范围由两个用连字符（-）分隔的数字表示。指定的范围包含边界值。

items.source: "0 0 * * * *" = the top of every hour of every day
items.translation: "0 0 * * * *" = 每天每小时的整点

items.source: "*/10 * * * * *" = every ten seconds
"0 0 8-10 * * *" = 8, 9 and 10 o'clock of every day
"0 0 6,19 * * *" = 6:00 AM and 7:00 PM every day
"0 0 9-17 * * MON-FRI" = on the hour nine-to-five weekdays
items.translation: "0 0 9-17 * * MON-FRI" = 周一至周五的九点到五点整点

items.source: "0 0 0 25 12 ?" = every Christmas Day at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 25 12 ?" = 每年圣诞节午夜

items.source: "0 0 0 L * *" = last day of the month at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 L * *" = 每月最后一天的午夜

items.source: "0 0 0 L-3 * *" = third-to-last day of the month at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 L-3 * *" = 每月倒数第三天的午夜

items.source: "0 0 0 1W * *" = first weekday of the month at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 1W * *" = 每月第一个工作日的午夜

items.source: "0 0 0 LW * *" = last weekday of the month at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 LW * *" = 每月最后一个工作日的午夜

items.source: "0 0 0 * * 5L" = last Friday of the month at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 * * 5L" = 每月最后一个星期五的午夜

items.source: "0 0 0 * * THUL" = last Thursday of the month at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 * * THUL" = 每月最后一个星期四的午夜

items.source: "0 0 0 ? * 5#2" = the second Friday in the month at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 ? * 5#2" = 每月第二个星期五的午夜

items.source: "0 0 0 ? * MON#1" = the first Monday in the month at midnight
items.translation: "0 0 0 ? * MON#1" = 每月的第一个星期一在午夜
